portInfo.description: A major port in Normandy, France, rebuilt after WWII and now a UNESCO World Heritage site for its modernist architecture.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Le Havre Cruise Terminal – Pointe de Floride — Quai Roger Meunier, 76000 Le Havre

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Le Havre beach and Volcan cultural centre (editorial).
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: If your documents say "Le Havre (Paris)", that is marketing. The train is over two hours each way. On calls under about 11 h, stay in Normandy.
